architecture.mechanism: Integration of smart materials to combine structure and actuator into a single element without discrete moving parts.
architecture.intervention: Replace the discrete mechanical starter motor and solenoid assembly with a monolithic shape memory polymer actuator integrated into the engine flywheel housing to eliminate mechanical binding during hot restarts.
architecture.expected_effect: Elimination of soft stalls caused by mechanical friction or solenoid latency in the start-stop system while maintaining engine operation in traffic.
architecture.falsification_test: Cycle the integrated SMA actuator through 10,000 hot-start simulations at 90°C ambient temperature; if the actuator fails to engage the flywheel within 200ms or exhibits hysteresis greater than 5%, the mechanism is falsified.

challenge.kill_reason: the mechanism-space distinctness adjudication counts 1 materially distinct mechanism(s) (< 2, mechanism_distinctness/2.0.0) — the run generated nothing worth attacking (Art. LXXXIV, R514)
